verdict.rationale: Relay documents several one-to-many actions — auto-transfer rules splitting funds across up to 20 accounts, issuing 50 cards at once to a team, and multi-step approval rules — which qualify as bulk operations within its banking workflows. However, there's no evidence of an API or programmatic interface an AI agent could use to trigger these bulk actions, nor documentation of bulk invoicing/payment batches beyond individual invoice creation. Missing for 10: API/developer docs for programmatic bulk actions, evidence of batch invoice/payment processing, and independent confirmation these bulk features work at scale.
